answer_1.quote: We design 12 task types, including both understanding and generation task types... generation task types: next chapter generation, conditional story generation, chapter infilling, global infilling, and temporal ordering.

answer_2.quote: we use BERTScore as the evaluation metric, as it has been shown... to have better correlation with human evaluation at both the story-level and system-level for story generation systems than other automatic metrics including frequently-used BLEU and ROUGE.
